question: HPCI shared storage: no first-party page read states a per-object cap, a retention period, or that rsync, rclone or scp work against it; the record's 'plan to remove data by project end' text (limits_note) was not found on the pages read. Which HPCI terms page (the Japanese shared-storage terms of use) states them?
why: per_object_cap.notes and retention.notes hold extraction placeholders that this unit could not replace with a quoted value; $.interface lists rsync and rclone, which the GridFTP page does not support.
